# Cut out a section

- Kind: `recipe`
- Category: `studio`
- Slug: `studio/split-and-delete`

## Summary

Darkroom recipe (basic). Split at both ends of the unwanted part and ripple-delete it so the rest closes the gap.

## Details

### When to use
A part of a clip should go.
### What a pro does and why
Always confirm the times before deleting.
### Ops
```json
{
  "summary": "Cut 10–14 s",
  "reason": "You asked to remove seconds 10 to 14, so I split at both ends and ripple delete the middle",
  "ops": [
    {"op": "split", "clipId": "CLIP_ID", "at": 10},
    {"op": "split", "clipId": "NEW_CLIP_ID", "at": 14},
    {"op": "delete_clip", "clipId": "MIDDLE_CLIP_ID", "ripple": true}
  ]
}
```
Ask with `ask_user` before running a delete; ids of the new pieces come from the digest after the splits.
### How to adjust
Cut too much: undo (one step) and split 0.5 s later. Jarring: add a short cross dissolve.
